method.description: Previously completed offline calculation only: reconstruct CSC from saved J_data/J_indices/J_indptr/J_shape, with saved r0 and row_weights. For each of four already-saved feasible points use both saved p and p_tail: v = r0 + row_weights*(J@p + J@p_tail); pred = 0.5*sum(r0*r0) - 0.5*sum(v*v). Compare with original persisted pred_lower/pred_upper. No native residual/tangent assembly, factorization, physical evaluation or new candidate search.

This direction exceeds the trust bound and was not certified or evaluated as a nonlinear candidate.
